title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1987-03-27
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > dBpoweramp > Samplitude Pro X4 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Recording is mislabeled; reviewers flag incorrect date and identifier with no comments on audio or performance.
ai_review.review: The handful of reviews focus almost entirely on the wrong metadata – several users point out that the tape is from March 27‑28 1989 in Atlanta, not a 1987 show, and request its removal. No reviewer mentions sound quality, mix, or musical highlights, leaving the actual performance undocumented.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers gave 4‑star ratings (but only about correct dating) and two gave 0 stars due to the misidentification; average rating is low and there is no performance or audio information.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No comments on sound quality; reviewers only discuss incorrect identifier and date.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No commentary on the musical flow or set structure.
